heading: This isn't your average to-do list
subheading: Three tasks. AI breakdowns. A pet that grows as you work. Yeah, it's different.

items.title: The Triple-Threat
items.body:
Only 3 tasks. Ever.
We cap your dashboard at three cards to eliminate choice paralysis. When one starts, another can join. No infinite scrolling, no overwhelm.

image.alt: Three task cards stacked, with a kitten care checklist popping out.

items.title: Friction Sort
items.body:
Momentum Ranking.
Don't pick what's "important." Our AI ranks tasks by how easy they are to start right now.

image.alt: A kitten task card with a flame icon, ranked by how easy it is to start.

items.title: Starting Streaks
items.body:
Celebrate the Start.
We don't care if you finished. We track the days you had the courage to begin.
